_meta: Full per-path AnimationClip curves (streamed + dense + constant) for every Appear<Rarity> clip in UILotteryCharacterAppear. Generated by _work/extract_character_appear_all_curves.py. Supersedes the partial character_appear_anim.json / *_charamodel_curves.json on the paths they overlap; this file covers ALL animated paths, not just charaModel. Attribute names use CRC32(name) reverse-lookup against a fixed table of known UI properties; unrecognised hashes appear as '?attr:<hex>'. Bone-transform attribute IDs 1-4 are translated to their readable component names (m_LocalScale.x etc.).
